verses.en: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.pt: As turmas dos filhos de Arão foram estas: os filhos de Arão: Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
verses.en_web: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.en_bbe: Now the divisions into which the sons of Aaron were grouped were these: the sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
verses.pt: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram antes de seu pai, e não tiveram filhos; por isso Eleazar e Itamar exerciam o sacerdócio.
verses.en_web: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
verses.en_bbe: But Nadab and Abihu came to their end before their father, and had no children; so Eleazar and Ithamar did the work of priests.

verses.en: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
verses.pt: E Davi, juntamente com Zadoque, dos filhos de Eleazar, e com Aimeleque, dos filhos de Itamar, os distribuiu segundo os deveres do seu serviço.
verses.en_web: David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
verses.en_bbe: And David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, made distribution of them into their positions for their work.

verses.en: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
verses.pt: E acharam-se mais chefes dentre os filhos de Eleazar do que dentre os filhos de Itamar; e assim foram distribuídos: dos filhos de Eleazar, chefes das casas paternas, dezesseis; e dos filhos de Itamar, segundo as suas casas paternas, oito.
verses.en_web: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
verses.en_bbe: And there were more chiefs among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar; and this is how they were grouped: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, all heads of families; and of the sons of Ithamar, heads of families, there were eight.

verses.en: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.pt: Assim foram distribuídos por sortes, tanto uns como os outros; porque havia príncipes do santuário e príncipes de Deus, tanto dentre os filhos de Eleazar, como dentre os filhos de Itamar.
verses.en_web: Thus were they divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.en_bbe: So they were put into groups, by the Lord's decision, one with another; for there were rulers of the holy place and rulers of the house of God among the sons of Eleazar and the sons of Ithamar.

verses.en: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.pt: E os registrou Semaías, filho de Netanel, o escrivão dentre os levitas, diante do rei, dos príncipes, de Zadoque, o sacerdote, de Aimeleque, filho de Abiatar, e dos chefes das casas paternas entre os sacerdotes e entre os levitas, tomando-se uma casa paterna para Eleazar, e outra para Itamar.
verses.en_web: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.en_bbe: And Shemaiah, the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was a Levite, put down their names in writing, the king being present with the rulers, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech, the son of Abiathar, and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites; one family being taken for Eleazar and then one for Ithamar, and so on.

verses.en: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.pt: Assim a primeira sorte saiu a Jeoiaribe, a segunda a Jedaías,
verses.en_web: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.en_bbe: Now the first name to come out was that of Jehoiarib; the second Jedaiah,

verses.en: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.pt: a terceira a Harim, a quarta a Seorim,
verses.en_web: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.en_bbe: The third Harim, the fourth Seorim,

verses.en: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.pt: a quinta a Malquias, a sexta a Miamim,
verses.en_web: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.en_bbe: The fifth Malchijah, the sixth Mijamin,

verses.en: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.pt: a sétima a Hacoz, a oitava a Abias,
verses.en_web: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.en_bbe: The seventh Hakkoz, the eighth Abijah,

verses.en: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.pt: a nona a Jesuá, a décima a Secanias,
verses.en_web: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.en_bbe: The ninth Jeshua, the tenth Shecaniah,

verses.en: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.pt: a undécima a Eliasibe, a duodécima a Jaquim,
verses.en_web: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.en_bbe: The eleventh Eliashib, the twelfth Jakim,

verses.en: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.pt: a décima terceira a Hupá, a décima quarta a Jesebeabe,
verses.en_web: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.en_bbe: The thirteenth Huppah, the fourteenth Jeshebeab,

verses.en: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.pt: a décima quinta a Bilga, a décima sexta a Imer,
verses.en_web: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.en_bbe: The fifteenth Bilgah, the sixteenth Immer,

verses.en: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
verses.pt: a décima sétima a Hezir, a décima oitava a Hapizes,
verses.en_web: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
verses.en_bbe: The seventeenth Hezir, the eighteenth Happizzez,

verses.en: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
verses.pt: a décima nona a Petaías, a vigésima a Jeezquel,
verses.en_web: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
verses.en_bbe: The nineteenth Pethahiah, the twentieth Jehezkel,

verses.en: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.pt: a vigésima primeira a Jaquim, a vigésima segunda a Gamul,
verses.en_web: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
verses.en_bbe: The twenty-first Jachin, the twenty-second Gamul,

verses.en: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.pt: a vigésima terceira a Delaías, a vigésima quarta a Maazias.
verses.en_web: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
verses.en_bbe: The twenty-third Delaiah, the twenty-fourth Maaziah.

verses.en: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.pt: Esta foi a distribuição deles no seu serviço, para entrarem na casa do Senhor, segundo lhes fora ordenado por Arão, seu pai, como o Senhor Deus de Israel lhe tinha mandado.
verses.en_web: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
verses.en_bbe: So they were put into their different groups, to take their places in the house of the Lord, in agreement with the rules made by Aaron their father, as the Lord, the God of Israel, had given him orders.

verses.en: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
verses.pt: Do restante dos filhos de Levi: dos filhos de Anrão, Subael; dos filhos de Subael, Jedeías.
verses.en_web: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
verses.en_bbe: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

verses.en: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
verses.pt: Quanto a Reabias: dos filhos de Reabias, Issijá o chefe;
verses.en_web: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
verses.en_bbe: Of Rehabiah; of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

verses.en: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
verses.pt: dos izaritas, Selomote; dos filhos de Selomote, Jaate;
verses.en_web: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
verses.en_bbe: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

verses.en: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Hebrom: Jerias o chefe, Amarias o segundo, Jaaziel o terceiro, Jecameão o quarto;
verses.en_web: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

verses.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Uziel, Mica; dos filhos de Mica, Samir;
verses.en_web: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

verses.en: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
verses.pt: o irmão de Mica, Issijá; dos filhos de Issijá, Zacarias.
verses.en_web: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
verses.en_bbe: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

verses.en: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Merári, Mali e Musi; dos filhos de Jaazias, Beno;
verses.en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah.

verses.en: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.pt: os filhos de Merári: de Jaazias: Beno, Soão, Zacur e Ibri;
verses.en_web: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Shoham and Zaccur and Ibri.

verses.en: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.pt: de Mali, Eleazar; e este não teve filhos.
verses.en_web: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.en_bbe: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

verses.en: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
verses.pt: Quanto a Quis: dos filhos de Quis, Jerameel;
verses.en_web: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
verses.en_bbe: Of Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.

verses.en: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
verses.pt: e os filhos de Musi: Mali, Eder e Jerimote. Esses foram os filhos dos levitas, segundo as suas casas paternas.
verses.en_web: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli and Eder and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites by their families.

verses.en: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
verses.pt: Estes também, como seus irmãos, os filhos de Arão, lançaram sortes diante do rei Davi, de Zadoque, de Aimeleque, e dos chefes das casas paternas entre os sacerdotes e entre os levitas; assim fizeram, tanto para o chefe de casa paterna, como para o seu irmão menor.
verses.en_web: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
verses.en_bbe: Selection was made of these in the same way as of their brothers the sons of Aaron, David the king being present, with Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites; the families of the chief in the same way as those of his younger brother.
